p: the prey departeth not: It never ceases to spoil and rob.
and the noise of the rattling: He shows how the Chaldeans will hasten, and how courageous their horses will be in beating the ground when they come against the Assyrians.
harlot: He compares Nineveh to a harlot, who by her beauty and subtilty entices young men, and brings them to destruction.
No: Meaning Alexandria, which had a compact of peace with so many nations, and yet was now destroyed.
Signifying that God's judgments would suddenly destroy the Assyrians, as these vermin do with rain or change of weather.
shepherds slumber: Your princes and counsellors.
whom hath not thy wickedness passed: Meaning that the Assyrians had done hurt to all people.
